purpose: Grades reasoning by its predictions, because reasoning cannot be inspected after the fact without being rewritten.

record.note: nothing has come due yet. The first grades land from October.

due.decision: Refresh the whole universe daily while it fits the budget; tier only as a fallback.
due.predicted: Daily refresh of everything will stay inside budget until the universe exceeds ~18,000 items. If we breach the allowance before then, the arithmetic was wrong.

due.decision: Treat the Charizard/Blastoise post as the specification for art content: same artist, both hero cards, a gap long enough to surprise, household Pokemon.
due.predicted: The next three art posts built to this spec will each get more engagement than the Keldeo-style recency pick would have. If a recency pick outperforms a spec pick, the model is wrong.
